control_flow: avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 % (dim), check the side sensors (left → turn left 20°, else right → turn right 20°, else driveInTheDark); if bright, driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dim, drive forward at 30 %; if bright, stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: In a dark tunnel, steer away from its walls: turn right when a wall is close on the left, turn left when it is on the right, to get through a bending tunnel without touching it.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim light, as inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim: it goes on to check the side obstacle sensors

decision_points.condition: in dim light: first the left obstacle sensor sees something, then the right one

not on the left, a wall is close on the right: it turns right 20° at 30 %
nothing close on either side: it calls driveInTheDark, which in the dark drives forward

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim light)
the front obstacle sensor sees something

branches.outcome: a wall is ahead: it stops

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light it turns left 20° when the left sensor sees a wall, and right 20° when the right sensor sees a wall.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts in a tunnel that bends, in dim light (left light sensor below 70 %).
scenarios.trigger: A wall of the bend comes close on one side, so that side's obstacle sensor sees it.
scenarios.title: Steers away from the walls of a bending tunnel
assumptions: You didn't say how close the wall must be: the obstacle sensors see a wall a few centimetres ahead.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns right when the wall is on its left and left when the wall is on its right, steering away, and gets through the bend without touching the walls.

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light, with no wall seen at the sides, it drives forward at 30 %.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts in a straight tunnel, in dim light, with its walls running along it, nothing close ahead-left or ahead-right.
scenarios.title: Drives forward in the dark when nothing is close
assumptions: You didn't say it explicitly, but between the walls the robot should drive forward to get through the tunnel.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives forward through the tunnel.

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it checks nothing ahead, follows the line (curve left on black, right otherwise), and stops when an obstacle is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts in bright light, on a black line.
scenarios.trigger: It follows the line; a wall stands across the line ahead.
scenarios.title: In bright light it follows the line and stops at a wall
assumptions: You only talked about the tunnel; in bright light the program follows a line and stops at walls, which looks like its other goal.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line and stops before a wall without bumping into it.

uncertainties: You said to turn away from the wall (right when it is on the left), but in dim light the program turns left when the left sensor sees a wall and right when the right sensor sees a wall: the opposite of what you asked.
Turning in 20° steps while the wall stays in view can make the robot circle instead of getting through the bend.
In bright light the program follows the line and stops at a wall, which your sentence doesn't mention.
The clap reads after each turn only throw away the robot's own noise and do nothing else.
